contract.goal: A decision-ready A/B test readout that leads with Ship, Don't ship or Inconclusive under the decision rule stated before the analysis, and reports the lift with its confidence interval and significance, every figure taken from the computed statistics or a cited source.

deliverables.description: The readout: the recommendation tied to the decision rule, the lift with its confidence interval and significance, the guardrail check, honest caveats and the next action
The computed figures behind the readout: rates per arm, lift, p-value, confidence interval and guardrail results

criteria.text: The readout is a full document organized under headings
The computed figures are saved as valid JSON
It makes a Ship, Don't ship or Inconclusive call

checks.label: a ship, don't-ship or inconclusive recommendation

criteria.text: It reports the lift with its confidence interval and whether it cleared significance

checks.label: a significance test or confidence interval for the lift

criteria.text: Every number in the readout appears in the computed figures or a source it cites, or is simple arithmetic on them; nothing new is invented
The recommendation follows from every clause of the decision rule, guardrails included, and the caveats on sample size, power and runtime are honest

judge.rubric: Does the recommendation follow from every clause of the pre-stated decision rule, guardrails included, and does the readout caveat sample size, power or runtime honestly and end with a concrete next action?
